notes.title: DEV UPDATE - Aug 31, 2019
notes.content:
[b]Preparing for Launch![/b]

I'm so excited to be in the final preparations for launch of Hover Tank Arena - Early Access. I want to encourage feedback and comments as you play through the game. Especially since I've decided to release the game as "Early Access".

I'm making minor adjustments to the Media Player for the in-game music today and working on some AI tweaks here in the last few hours before release.

[b]Your Voice is Important[/b]

As the game continues to evolve and grow, what you notice, what you feel, and what you think are important in helping to guide the direction of development.

I look forward to hearing your feedback.
